summary: Reports on tests of what happens to common Internet applications when service providers add a second layer of NAT (carrier-grade NAT, as in NAT444) while transitioning to IPv6. It identifies where the extra translation breaks or degrades applications, and was updated to cover Dual-Stack Lite as well.

eli5.summary: When your message passes through two translators instead of one, some things get lost in translation. This lists which things go wrong.
